capabilities: Transcribe photographed or scanned handwriting via Google Gemini
Capture images from camera, clipboard, vault files, or drag-and-drop
Review and edit the transcription in a preview before inserting
Customize the OCR prompt and choose a Gemini model
Convert iPhone HEIC photos for preview on desktop
extras: Images are uploaded to Google's Gemini API for processing; the plugin stores no data itself and collects no telemetry. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Supports mobile (iOS and Android) and lists preview models Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to recognize handwriting in photos or screenshots, so getting paper notes into a vault means transcribing them manually or using outside tools.

relations.evidence: transcribes handwritten pages into text using Google Gemini AI

summary: Handwriting OCR plugin that sends photographed pages to Google Gemini and inserts the transcribed text at the cursor in the active note.
